# archestra_knowledge_connector (Data Source)

Looks up an existing knowledge connector by ID. `credentials.api_token` is never exposed — secrets stay on the backend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing knowledge connector. The polymorphic `config`
# is returned as a JSON string with the discriminator `type` stripped
# — round-trips cleanly into a resource block if you decide to import.

data "archestra_knowledge_connector" "jira" {
  id = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
}

output "jira_config" {
  value     = data.archestra_knowledge_connector.jira.config
  sensitive = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Connector UUID.

### Read-Only

- `config` (String) Connector-type-specific configuration as a JSON string. The discriminator `type` field is stripped — it's encoded in `connector_type`.
- `connector_type` (String) Type of upstream system (jira, github, notion, …).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Free-form description, if set.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector runs on its schedule.
- `last_sync_at` (String) Most recent sync attempt timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `last_sync_error` (String) Error message from the most recent failed sync, or null if the last run succeeded.
- `last_sync_status` (String) Status of the most recent sync run.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `schedule` (String) Cron expression controlling sync cadence.
- `secret_id` (String) Internal secret-manager handle for the stored credentials.
- `team_ids` (List of String) Team IDs the connector is scoped to (empty unless `visibility = "team-scoped"`).
- `total_docs_ingested` (Number) Total document count ingested across all syncs (a running counter; the backend returns it as a float for paginated histories).
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `visibility` (String) `org-wide` or `team-scoped`.
